system.description:
Starting Move. When you retroactively declare how you prepared for something in advance, spend Prep as determined by the GM using the guideline below. As a consequence during a flashback the GM may say something costs extra Prep. If you spend more Prep than you have, take a condition for each remaining Prep.

• 1 Prep - Ordinary action, easy opportunity, no rolls required, a short time ago.
• 2 Prep - Complex action, unlikely opportunity, one roll required, some time ago.
• 3 Prep - Elaborate action, special opportunity, several rolls required, a long time ago.
